newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit ends up vs dollar, stays in tight range.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit ends up vs dollar, stays in tight range.

text.p: The ringgit closed slightly higher against the dollar on further short covering after a strong dollar/majors had weighed on the local currency on Wednesday, dealers said.
Ringgit's rise, however, was capped at 2.5045/50 on dollar buying by Singapore traders, they said.
"Trading range was tight throughout as players were not really trying to push the ringgit either way," said a local bank dealer.
Dealers said news of a 600 million ringgit trade surplus for August continued to support the ringgit.
Malaysia recorded a 615 million ringgit trade deficit in July.

Dealers said trading was cautious ahead of the release of U.S. trade data on Friday. They said expectations of a favourable 1997 budget to be presented on October 25 could keep a steady undertone for the ringgit.
At the local 1000 GMT close, the ringgit was at 2.5057/67 per dollar against 2.5064/74 on Wednesday.
